query: user-centric agents co-evolve environment and user simulator
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The exact match. Introduces a framework that jointly evolves the agent policy, user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration. People: Min Cai and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **UserBench: An Interactive Gym Environment for User-Centric Agents** — Closely related benchmark featuring simulated users with underspecified, evolving preferences. People: Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research; University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign), Heng Ji (UIUC), and Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Zhiwei Liu, Jianguo Zhang, Haolin Chen, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.22034)

3. **Faithful Simulation of User–Agent–Environment Interactions for Scalable LLM Agent Evaluation** — Models the user, agent, and environment in one closed interaction loop and studies how user archetypes and environment reliability affect performance. People: Aleksei Kudrinskii and Saibo Geng (EPFL); Luca Beurer-Kellner and Marc Fischer (Snyk). [OpenReview PDF](https://openreview.net/pdf/58880fd5d365a14526e43a4459fa09c424f17f7e.pdf)

4. **Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants** — Introduces Pare, where an active user simulator and assistant operate inside a shared, stateful application environment. People: Deepak Nathani, Cheng Zhang, Chang Huan, Jiaming Shan, Yinfei Yang, Alkesh Patel, Zhe Gan, William Yang Wang, Michael Saxon, and Xin Eric Wang; affiliations include UC Santa Barbara, Apple, University of Washington, and an independent researcher. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.00842)

query: meta-agent modifies training environment during multi-turn reinforcement learning
text:
The query points strongly to one exact-match paper and its companion pages:

1. **“EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents”** — Introduces a meta-agent that modifies the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration during multi-turn training.  
   **People:** Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Amii).  
   **URL:** [arXiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **EAU project page** — Companion site linked by the paper, covering the environment–agent–user co-evolution framework.  
   **People/affiliations:** Same research team listed above.  
   **URL:** [eau-meta-agent.github.io](https://eau-meta-agent.github.io/)

3. **Independent EAU paper review** — Summarizes the reported gains and raises a key caveat: baseline comparisons do not use matched end-to-end compute budgets.  
   **People/affiliations:** Reviews work by Cai, Zhang, Xing, Ma, Xu, and Ye, affiliated with the University of Alberta, NUS, Kuaishou Technology, Amii, and independent research.  
   **URL:** [Pith review](https://pith.science/paper/2610.16523)
